prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1260; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked and the trunk lid shows a crease running across its upper edge, with the tail lamp assembly broken on the driver side. The bent reinforcement bar and damaged quarter panel match the force of a rear-end impact described in the claim. Repair will involve replacing the bumper cover and tail lamp, straightening the trunk lid, and refinishing the affected panels. The labor hours requested fit the extent of the damage, and the parts list and invoices show no duplicated charges. Nothing on the vehicle suggests earlier damage to these areas, and the repair plan is recommended as submitted.
